summary.text: Barbara Freiberg is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 70, representing East Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Barbara Freiberg with committee assignments including Municipal (Parochial and Cultural Affairs, Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Barbara Freiberg's occupation as Retired Educator.
It lists Barbara Freiberg's education as Lee High School; B.A., Louisiana Tech University; M.A., University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

The House member page lists Barbara Freiberg's committee assignments as Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs (Vice Chair); Appropriations; Education; House Select Committee on Women and Children (Chair); Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget; Legislative Audit Advisory Council.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
